crossRefs.note: The wicked shall be turned back to Sheol, even all the nations that forget God.
On the wicked he will rain blazing coals; fire, sulfur, and scorching wind shall be the portion of their cup.
Woe to the wicked! Disaster is upon them; for the deeds of his hands will be paid back to him.
The light of the righteous shines brightly, but the lamp of the wicked is snuffed out.
Whoever curses his father or his mother, his lamp shall be put out in blackness of darkness.
“Yes, the light of the wicked will be put out. The spark of his fire won’t shine.
The light will be dark in his tent. His lamp above him will be put out.
“How often is it that the lamp of the wicked is put out, that their calamity comes on them, that God distributes…
but the children of the Kingdom will be thrown out into the outer darkness. There will be weeping and gnashing of…
The foolish said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil, for our lamps are going out.’
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been…

translations.web: for there will be no reward to the evil man. The lamp of the wicked will be snuffed out.
translations.bsb: For the evil man has no future; the lamp of the wicked will be extinguished.
translations.kjv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; the candle of the wicked shall be put out.
translations.asv: For there shall be no reward to the evil man; The lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
